title: Junior Network Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Junior Network Engineer to join our dynamic team at Pinterest. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 3 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Project Management, TypeScript, React, Node.js
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of CZK 800,000 – CZK 1,200,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

We are looking for a talented Director of PR Manager to join our dynamic team at HubSpot. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining marketing solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 4 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in SEO, HubSpot, Analytics, Email Marketing
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of CZK 2,400,000 – CZK 3,500,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Director of Risk Analyst
description:
Cloudflare is seeking a Director of Risk Analyst who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Director of Risk Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our data capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute data initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 1+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Analytical Thinking, Python, Problem Solving, Project Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: CZK 1,200,000 – CZK 1,700,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

We are looking for a talented Junior Recruiter to join our dynamic team at CrowdStrike. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining design solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 1 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, UI/UX, Analytical Thinking, Stakeholder Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of CZK 2,400,000 – CZK 3,500,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Director of Cloud Architect
description:
Join Apple as a Director of Cloud Architect and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Director of Cloud Architect with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 9 years of experience as a Director of Cloud Architect or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Git, JavaScript, Microservices, Team Management
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: CZK 500,000 – CZK 800,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities
